component.title: FormSection
component.purpose: A semantic section that keeps form hierarchy, validation context, and optional disclosure coherent.

states.description: A readable group of related fields.
A visible issue count keeps recovery context near the section.

claims.statement: The section preserves heading, field grouping, and live validation context without requiring consumer layout glue.
Collapsible sections use a native button with an accurate expanded relationship and remain keyboard-operable.
Section padding and field rhythm remain readable on narrow screens without horizontal overflow.
